What are SEEN Beach Club's opening hours? | The beach club at CLUB SEEN is open daily from 11:00 to 23:00, and SEEN Eatery serves from 11:30 with last orders at 22:30. On selected event nights the indoor UNSEEN Club Room hosts an after-party from 23:00, which needs its own ticket.
Is SEEN Beach Club the same as Club SEEN? | Yes. SEEN Beach Club Samui relaunched in December 2025 as CLUB SEEN Koh Samui, with SEEN Eatery for food, the main stage by the pools and the UNSEEN Club Room for late sets. It is the same venue on Chaweng Beach, next door to the Avani Chaweng Samui Hotel & Beach Club.
Can children or teenagers go to Club SEEN? | Not in high season: from 19 December 2026 to 27 March 2027 the club is 18+ every day, and all events and night parties are 18+ with ID. Outside that period it has admitted 14+ on regular days and all ages on Wednesday and Sunday family days, and Avani Chaweng says under-18s may visit until 19:00, so check before you go.
Do you have to pay to get into SEEN Beach Club? | On ordinary days there is no ticket, but daybeds, sofas and tables carry a minimum spend paid in advance, in 11:00–17:00 or 18:00–23:00 slots. Event days are ticketed: a July 2026 event cost 500++ THB, O Beach Sundays start at 800 THB, and event table packages started at 8,000++ THB.
When is the Club SEEN season opening for 2026? | The Season Opening is listed for Saturday 26 December 2026, from 14:00 to 20:00, with Mahmut Orhan headlining. It is followed by O Beach Ibiza x CLUB SEEN every Sunday from 27 December 2026 to 14 February 2027.
What are Club SEEN Sundays? | From 27 December 2026 to 14 February 2027, the club's Sundays are run with O Beach Ibiza, with DJs, dancers and aerial shows. One ticket from 800 THB covers one entry on any of the eight Sundays, without food or drinks. Published times differ (12:00–23:00 on the ticket listing, 21:00–02:00 on one events calendar), so go by your ticket.
What happens to my Club SEEN ticket if it rains? | Under the club's 2025–26 ticket rules, tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable, and if rain or another natural event stops the party they convert to food and drink credit. Table deposits are also non-refundable.
Is there a dress code at SEEN Beach Club? | The club asks for "beach chic" at all times and proper swimwear in the pools. In practice, smart swimwear and a cover-up by day, and smart-casual resort wear for the evening events, will get you in.
How do I get to SEEN Beach Club from Lamai or Bophut? | It is about 12 km and 20–25 minutes from Lamai (Grab about 200–350 THB) and about 9 km and 15–20 minutes from Bophut (about 150–250 THB). Chaweng Beach Road is congested from late afternoon, so leave early on event days, and book a driver for the trip home after midnight.
Can you watch the sunset at SEEN Beach Club? | Not over the sea. Chaweng faces east, so the sun goes down behind the club at about 18:00 and the sky just softens. For a sunset view, go to the north-coast clubs in Bang Rak, such as Chi Samui, or to the west coast.
